nodes.label: Timeline API
nodes.rationale: Uses immutable operation IDs and per-Thing head revisions; divergence refuses without modifying published content.

nodes.label: MongoDB Health Failure Shape
nodes.rationale: Preserves the full connection status response when remote probes fail, while making clear that HTTP 200 does not indicate a connected database.

nodes.label: Remote Filesystem Commands
nodes.rationale: Provides bounded filesystem operations over existing device routes and explicitly excludes arbitrary filesystem HTTP paths.

nodes.label: Integration Library Runtime
nodes.rationale: Uses fixed read-only provider operations, bounded and redacted transport, and a separately restricted SDK document; browser keys are excluded from saved Things.

nodes.label: Browser Action Programs
nodes.rationale: Adds capabilities through saved, editable program data and existing runtime contracts without adding endpoint-specific UI behavior or unnecessary endpoints and permissions.

nodes.label: Lopu Action Access
nodes.rationale: Gates mutations and Actions per chat and routes delegable data through the shared canonical map.

Named-Branch Comparison

nodes.label: Timeline Branch Checkout
nodes.rationale: Adds a transient snapshot while preserving the canonical entry and existing branch-edit write path.

nodes.label: Webpage Component Previews
nodes.rationale: Reuses the viewer-only batch resolver with bounded blocks and exact scope, without granting page or root access.

nodes.label: Timeline Component Bindings
nodes.rationale: Bounds dependency count, decoded payload size, and response size, and refuses unknown or duplicate selectors, foreign accounts, and stale sources.

nodes.label: Timeline Branch-Merge Component Choices
nodes.rationale: Preflights metadata before batched captures and enforces aggregate response bounds without introducing a new route, collection, or schema.

nodes.label: api.passwords 1.3.0
nodes.rationale: Private session-bound home-plane API protects password-manager-entry Things; client avoids shared diagnostics and caches so decrypted fields do not enter shared history.

nodes.label: Password generator and settings blocks
nodes.rationale: Secret output stays in the controlled entry draft.

nodes.label: api.integration-ios-release 1.0.0
nodes.rationale: Production-only release registration negotiates origin capability before one-time GitHub OIDC credential delivery or explicitly enabled create-only migration.

nodes.label: Password migration and encrypted file lifecycle
Admin migration status and run contracts
nodes.rationale: Guarded incident-cleanup contracts require both negotiated versions; absent local Mongo/JWT settings return a no-store 503 before handler or body execution.

nodes.label: api.ai-chatgpt-plan 1.2.0
nodes.rationale: Desktop uses OS-protected device storage, verifies the session with its selected account API, and preserves remote self-hosted runtimes.

nodes.label: api.lopu-chats-reply 1.22.0
nodes.rationale: Device pin is routed only on the desktop owning the grant; hosted inference and billing fallback are absent.

nodes.label: api.lopu-chats-device-turns 1.0.0
nodes.rationale: Transcript route supports text history and idempotent private transcript writes but cannot invoke models, tools, Actions, or billing.

nodes.label: api.things 1.41.0–1.56.0
nodes.rationale: Versions are derived from canonical registries and manifests; additive contracts retain shared ACL and scope checks.

nodes.label: Mapbox provider integration
nodes.rationale: Provider destinations are fixed and responses redacted; the application permits only Mapbox service and events origins in connect-src and loads the official SDK from same-origin staged assets.

nodes.label: api.maps 1.0.0–1.1.0
nodes.rationale: Operations use full-account authorization, owner-scoped Vault references, rate limits, fixed provider destinations, and response redaction.

nodes.label: Storage readiness and recovery
nodes.rationale: Storage recovery uses shared deferred-accounting semantics, honest recovery states, allowlisted failures, and transactional queue/worker/controller gates.

nodes.label: Connections catalog, account and OAuth contracts
nodes.rationale: Owner-private encrypted grants replace shared tokens, while OAuth app configuration is scoped to exact origin and environment.

nodes.label: Connections API contracts 2.0.0–2.1
nodes.rationale: Contracts cover catalog, account/list, unlink, feed, filters, OAuth, named grants, and provider artwork.

nodes.label: api.connections-provider-icon 1.0.0
nodes.rationale: Public artwork is served on the document origin without a data-plane connection or forwarding user headers to providers.

nodes.label: Write-only credential handoff
nodes.rationale: Credential handoff binds exact import headers, refuses generic origin fallback and background dispatch, and returns private no-store destination metadata, status, and receipts.

nodes.label: Environment gateway and index readiness
nodes.rationale: Gateway performs bounded discovery, admission, pool draining, origin-preserving signed relay validation, and index readiness without blocking read-only authentication.

nodes.label: Public social metadata
nodes.rationale: Anonymous projections use explicit allowlists, refuse remote URLs, avoid resolving caller identity, and return generic metadata for private or missing content.

nodes.label: api.social-card 1.3.0–1.4.0
nodes.rationale: Shares template IDs and layout choices; route defaults come from the actual browser router, avoiding a parallel backend metadata registry.

nodes.label: Public webpage content projection
nodes.rationale: Public metadata infers supported visible copy and managed images; runtime sources, Actions, private bindings, and system layouts are never executed or inferred.

nodes.label: Named Connections management
nodes.rationale: The named-grant operation verifies exact actor, origin, connection ID, and a fixed operation; token envelopes never cross the response boundary.

nodes.label: Dynamic map workspaces
nodes.rationale: Map points sources retain existing source authorization and cursor paths; a failed refresh clears only that layer.

nodes.label: api.actions-run 1.40.0–1.44.0
nodes.rationale: Expression protocol versions are negotiated; URL encoding performs no HTTP operation, and execution admission refuses held content.

nodes.label: api.timeline 1.19.1–1.19.2
nodes.rationale: Iterative traversal removes hidden depth and block limits while existing authorization and capture contracts remain.

nodes.label: Shared-content request transport
nodes.rationale: Authorization and rate limits precede streaming fatal UTF-8 decoding; completion enumerates parts server-side and presigning pages every part.

nodes.label: Reviewed creation projections and execution admission
nodes.rationale: Held creation content remains non-executable until supported admission checks allow it; no restore route is added.

nodes.label: Client discovery failure classification
nodes.rationale: Temporary failures may retain only a same-scope readable template while execution remains unverified and inert; malformed, incompatible, wrong-origin, and authorization failures cannot retain protected projections.

nodes.label: API Endpoints and Capabilities Feature Map
Account-file Restore Writer Epoch Corrections
nodes.rationale: Fences writes, moves, and drains of held restored content through the root content epoch; trusted transaction composition and audit labels remain internal options.

nodes.label: Backup Dispatch Recovery
nodes.rationale: Scheduler dispatch reserves opaque attempt IDs before SDK start and maintains original-session and transaction/lease fences; browser calls cannot supply workflow run IDs, store addresses, original sessions, or runnable intent.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/backups/run and POST /api/v1/backups/run
nodes.rationale: GET uses the existing scheduler secret; POST requires full same-origin administrator permission and accepts no selectors or payload.

nodes.label: First-party Backup Workspace
nodes.rationale: Browser reads do not obtain provider configuration, session references, execution leases, or writable intents.

nodes.label: Saved Private Page Activation
nodes.rationale: Activation verifies the exact private owner, page, revision, action, date, and literal saved inputs; viewer safeguards prevent manual page query selection and keep preview, edit, and shared execution inert.
